purpose: High-signal avatar discovery and runtime-representation evidence for catalog collections that use or onboard through OpenPage.

communities.catalog_value: description, X, Discord, website, logo and source timestamps; identity remains unbound until explicit mapping

mml_metadata.catalog_value: MML/runtime definition lead; inspect referenced model sources without inferring VRM

mml.notes: Preserve MML URLs independently. Inspect m-character and m-model src attributes for underlying model leads. MML itself never proves VRM.

vrm.notes: Creator-provided .vrm URLs are strong discovery leads but must still pass the catalog structural VRM probe and exhaustive-inventory rules.

glb.notes: GLB/GLTF proves a 3D model representation, not VRM. Never promote GLB/GLTF to the VRM inventory lane.

identity_policy.unmapped_records: Keep as discovery leads; do not silently attach them to a catalog collection by display name alone.

curator_note: OpenPage is expected to become an important onboarding source for collections using MML. Treat the source as additive discovery coverage, never as a relaxation of the literal catalog completeness bar.
